model.name: Mamba 130M
model.positions: none: order comes from the causal conv1d and the scan
model.mask: causal (the scan only carries state forward)

examples.title: Coreference
examples.prompt: The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired

examples.title: Repeated phrase
examples.prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown

examples.title: Two names
examples.prompt: When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to

capture.x: input to the mixer, after the block RMSNorm
capture.out: output of out_proj, before the residual add
capture.matrix: computed in float64 from the captured Δ, A, B, C; checked against the recurrence

extras.channels: Index of each chosen channel in the 1536-wide inner dimension. In each layer, the 8 of 1536 channels whose scan output takes the most from earlier tokens: the largest Σ_t Σ_{s<t} |M_c[t, s] · x_s[c]|, summed over the three examples. Listed from most to least.
extras.q: C_t, the 16-D readout selected from x by x_proj; shared by every channel
extras.k: B_s, the 16-D input selected from x by x_proj; shared by every channel
extras.v: x_s[c]: the scan input, after in_proj, conv1d and SiLU
extras.weights: M_c[t, s], the scan as a causal matrix (D·x not included)
extras.A: A[c, n] = −exp(A_log[c, n]), 16 decay rates per channel
extras.D: D[c], the skip weight: y = heads + D · x
extras.y: scan output heads + D · x, before the gate
extras.gate: SiLU(z_t[c]), the gate multiplied into y before out_proj
